## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that fixes it.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation correction
- [ ] New guide or FAQ entry
- [ ] Original asset or preview
- [ ] Maintenance or link update

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated problem.
- [ ] No binaries, archives, source dumps, license keys, or private configs are included.
- [ ] No account names, tokens, session data, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Relative links and images resolve.
- [ ] New assets are original or properly licensed.
- [ ] The wording does not promise detection status or account safety.
- [ ] `scripts/validate.ps1` passes.

## Verification

Explain how you checked the change. For a guide, mention the build and client it
applies to. Do not attach account data or executable files.
